current_behavior: Counts substring hits of per-intent keyword lists in the lower-cased query and takes the intent with the most hits (generic_chat if none; 'was ist'/'what is' with a project domain upgrades to implemented_code_explanation); ui_config trigger modes may override.

question.instructions: Decide which kind of project-knowledge retrieval this chat question needs.

options.implemented_code_explanation: Explain how existing implemented code works: a function, class, method, module, file, mechanism, or 'what is / what does X' about a project component; show me the code for X.
options.architecture_overview: Describe the structure of a system: architecture, overview, components, dependencies, how parts relate, data/control flow, without asking for a diagram or a complete full-system analysis.
options.docs_overview: Asks for documentation material: docs, README, guide, manual/Anleitung, runbook document, ADR, concept paper.
options.tutorial_help: Asks to learn or be guided: how do I / how to, step-by-step instructions, beginner help, examples.
options.game_design: About the design of the Ananta game: levels, game mechanics, rules, points/score, challenges.
options.ops_runbook: Operating the running system: restart, deploy, monitoring, alerts, on-call, recovery, configuration and setup of the installation.
options.mermaid_request: Asks for a diagram of a specific part: mermaid, flowchart, sequence diagram, class or ER diagram.
options.architecture_full_scan: Asks for a complete whole-system analysis: full architecture diagram, overall architecture, full scan, all relevant components, dependency map.
options.generic_chat: Smalltalk or a general question that needs no retrieval from project knowledge.

provenance: Every classify_retrieval_intent call in tests/ that asserts the intent with an empty ui_config. Skipped: domain-only assertions, and intent assertions that depend on ui_config (tutorial_mode, chat_codecompass_trigger_mode force_codecompass/force_repo_first/disabled), because the state here is the query text only. docs_overview, tutorial_help and architecture_full_scan have no text-only test case.
